subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Fit as a fiddle

options.text: In a very good physical condition

solution:
The correct answer is** 'In a very good physical condition '.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Fit as a fiddle"** best expresses the meaning of: 'In a very good physical condition'
 
• **"Fit as a fiddle" **is an idiom used to describe someone who is in excellent health or physical condition.
 
• **"In a very good physical condition"**: This refers to someone who is healthy and physically fit. (बहुत अच्छी शारीरिक स्थिति में)

Therfore, the **correct answer** is: 'In a very good physical condition'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's explain all the given options along with their English and Hindi meanings:
 
 
• **"To be in love"**: This refers to the emotional state of deep affection for someone.(प्यार में होना)
 
• **"To drink alcohol regularly":** This means the consistent consumption of alcoholic beverages.(नियमित रूप से शराब पीना)
 
• **"To be firm":** This refers to someone who is steadfast, resolute, or unwavering in their beliefs or decisions.(दृढ़ होना)
 
 

1be:T704,

The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**
